```{=html}
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Oswald:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Barlow:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;0,700;1,400;1,500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

<div id="pitch" aria-hidden="true"></div>
<svg id="field-svg" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" aria-hidden="true"></svg>
<div id="sprite-layer" aria-hidden="true"></div>
<div id="pitch-overlay" aria-hidden="true"></div>

<script>
(function(){
  /* ---- fixed, viewport-sized horizontal pitch (matches the PDF) ---- */
  function rect(x,y,w,h,lw){return '<rect x="'+x+'" y="'+y+'" width="'+w+'" height="'+h+'" fill="none" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.42)" stroke-width="'+lw+'"/>';}
  function circ(cx,cy,r){return '<circle cx="'+cx+'" cy="'+cy+'" r="'+r+'" fill="none" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.42)" stroke-width="2"/>';}
  function dot(cx,cy,r){return '<circle cx="'+cx+'" cy="'+cy+'" r="'+r+'" fill="rgba(255,255,255,0.42)"/>';}
  function arc(d){return '<path d="'+d+'" fill="none" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.42)" stroke-width="2"/>';}
  
  function drawField(){
    var svg=document.getElementById('field-svg'); if(!svg) return;
    var d=document.documentElement;
    var W=d.clientWidth, H=d.clientHeight; if(H<200) return;
    svg.setAttribute('viewBox','0 0 '+W+' '+H);
    svg.setAttribute('width',W); svg.setAttribute('height',H);
    var pad=Math.round(Math.min(W,H)*0.05);
    var fx=pad, fy=pad, fw=W-2*pad, fh=H-2*pad, mx=fx+fw/2, my=fy+fh/2;
    var paH=fh*0.56, paW=fw*0.155, paY=fy+(fh-paH)/2;
    var gaH=fh*0.26, gaW=fw*0.055, gaY=fy+(fh-gaH)/2;
    var cr=Math.max(56,Math.min(fh*0.20, fw*0.13)), spot=fw*0.10, c=Math.max(14,fw/80);
    svg.innerHTML =
      rect(fx,fy,fw,fh,3)
      +'<line x1="'+mx+'" y1="'+fy+'" x2="'+mx+'" y2="'+(fy+fh)+'" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.42)" stroke-width="2"/>'
      +circ(mx,my,cr)+dot(mx,my,5)
      +rect(fx,paY,paW,paH,2)+rect(fx,gaY,gaW,gaH,2)+dot(fx+spot,my,4)
      +rect(fx+fw-paW,paY,paW,paH,2)+rect(fx+fw-gaW,gaY,gaW,gaH,2)+dot(fx+fw-spot,my,4)
      +arc('M '+(fx+c)+' '+fy+' A '+c+' '+c+' 0 0 1 '+fx+' '+(fy+c))
      +arc('M '+(fx+fw-c)+' '+fy+' A '+c+' '+c+' 0 0 0 '+(fx+fw)+' '+(fy+c))
      +arc('M '+fx+' '+(fy+fh-c)+' A '+c+' '+c+' 0 0 1 '+(fx+c)+' '+(fy+fh))
      +arc('M '+(fx+fw)+' '+(fy+fh-c)+' A '+c+' '+c+' 0 0 0 '+(fx+fw-c)+' '+(fy+fh));
  }

  /* ---- Page-by-Page sprite LAYOUTS ----
     Each page gets its own arrangement of positions on the pitch (fractions of
     the viewport). The actual sprite image for each slot is chosen at render
     time by cycling through whatever sprites are available (see placeSprites),
     so no page depends on a fixed sprite id existing — and every page looks
     different from the next. Goal-mouth slots come first (x≈0.05 / 0.95),
     then a sideline slot, then outfield players scattered uniquely per page. */
  var PAGE_LAYOUTS = [
    // PAGE 0 — hero
    [ {x:0.06,y:0.46},{x:0.94,y:0.54},{x:0.50,y:0.05},{x:0.22,y:0.50},
      {x:0.30,y:0.22},{x:0.70,y:0.30},{x:0.86,y:0.72},{x:0.40,y:0.90},
      {x:0.62,y:0.84},{x:0.14,y:0.78} ],
    // PAGE 1
    [ {x:0.05,y:0.55},{x:0.95,y:0.45},{x:0.50,y:0.94},{x:0.12,y:0.30},
      {x:0.28,y:0.62},{x:0.46,y:0.40},{x:0.64,y:0.66},{x:0.82,y:0.28},
      {x:0.90,y:0.60},{x:0.20,y:0.88} ],
    // PAGE 2
    [ {x:0.07,y:0.50},{x:0.93,y:0.50},{x:0.04,y:0.10},{x:0.18,y:0.70},
      {x:0.34,y:0.32},{x:0.50,y:0.78},{x:0.66,y:0.24},{x:0.80,y:0.66},
      {x:0.92,y:0.16},{x:0.40,y:0.12} ],
    // PAGE 3
    [ {x:0.06,y:0.40},{x:0.94,y:0.60},{x:0.96,y:0.08},{x:0.16,y:0.20},
      {x:0.24,y:0.84},{x:0.42,y:0.54},{x:0.58,y:0.28},{x:0.74,y:0.80},
      {x:0.88,y:0.44},{x:0.34,y:0.70} ],
    // PAGE 4
    [ {x:0.05,y:0.52},{x:0.95,y:0.48},{x:0.06,y:0.90},{x:0.20,y:0.34},
      {x:0.36,y:0.68},{x:0.50,y:0.18},{x:0.62,y:0.56},{x:0.78,y:0.32},
      {x:0.86,y:0.82},{x:0.30,y:0.94} ],
    // PAGE 5
    [ {x:0.07,y:0.44},{x:0.93,y:0.56},{x:0.92,y:0.92},{x:0.14,y:0.64},
      {x:0.26,y:0.26},{x:0.44,y:0.82},{x:0.56,y:0.40},{x:0.70,y:0.70},
      {x:0.84,y:0.22},{x:0.48,y:0.06} ],
    // PAGE 6
    [ {x:0.06,y:0.50},{x:0.94,y:0.50},{x:0.50,y:0.04},{x:0.18,y:0.42},
      {x:0.18,y:0.74},{x:0.40,y:0.24},{x:0.40,y:0.86},{x:0.62,y:0.30},
      {x:0.62,y:0.78},{x:0.84,y:0.56} ],
    // PAGE 7
    [ {x:0.05,y:0.58},{x:0.95,y:0.42},{x:0.50,y:0.95},{x:0.12,y:0.22},
      {x:0.30,y:0.50},{x:0.22,y:0.82},{x:0.48,y:0.32},{x:0.66,y:0.64},
      {x:0.80,y:0.20},{x:0.90,y:0.78} ],
    // PAGE 8
    [ {x:0.07,y:0.48},{x:0.93,y:0.52},{x:0.04,y:0.16},{x:0.16,y:0.78},
      {x:0.32,y:0.36},{x:0.46,y:0.66},{x:0.58,y:0.22},{x:0.72,y:0.54},
      {x:0.86,y:0.30},{x:0.88,y:0.86} ],
    // PAGE 9
    [ {x:0.06,y:0.54},{x:0.94,y:0.46},{x:0.96,y:0.90},{x:0.14,y:0.34},
      {x:0.26,y:0.72},{x:0.40,y:0.46},{x:0.54,y:0.74},{x:0.68,y:0.34},
      {x:0.82,y:0.62},{x:0.36,y:0.10} ],
    // PAGE 10 — end
    [ {x:0.06,y:0.48},{x:0.94,y:0.52},{x:0.50,y:0.06},{x:0.20,y:0.28},
      {x:0.30,y:0.70},{x:0.46,y:0.40},{x:0.60,y:0.82},{x:0.72,y:0.26},
      {x:0.84,y:0.66},{x:0.16,y:0.88} ]
  ];

  var currentPageIndex = 0;

  /* Collect only the sprites that actually loaded (non-empty data URIs). */
  function availableSprites(){
    var out=[];
    if(window.SPRITES){
      for(var i=0;i<SPRITES.length;i++){ if(SPRITES[i]) out.push(SPRITES[i]); }
    }
    return out;
  }

  function placeSprites(){
    var layer=document.getElementById('sprite-layer');
    if(!layer) return;
    var sprites=availableSprites();
    if(!sprites.length) return;

    var layout = PAGE_LAYOUTS[currentPageIndex] || PAGE_LAYOUTS[0];
    var d=document.documentElement, W=d.clientWidth, H=d.clientHeight;
    layer.innerHTML='';

    // Rotate the sprite set per page so adjacent pages don't share a starting
    // sprite. Step of 7 is coprime to typical sprite counts, so even small sets
    // (e.g. 3 sprites) produce a different sequence on every page. Consecutive
    // slots (i, i+1) always differ, so no two neighbours share a sprite.
    var off = currentPageIndex * 7;

    layout.forEach(function(pos, i){
      var src = sprites[(i + off) % sprites.length];
      if(!src) return;

      var sz  = 44 + ((i + currentPageIndex) % 3) * 9;          // 44 / 53 / 62
      var rot = ((i % 2) ? 1 : -1) * (4 + ((i + currentPageIndex) % 9));
      var img = document.createElement('img');
      img.src = src; img.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
      img.style.cssText =
        'position:absolute;left:'+Math.round(pos.x*W - sz/2)+'px;top:'+
        Math.round(pos.y*H - sz/2)+'px;width:'+sz+'px;height:auto;opacity:0.78;'+
        'transform:rotate('+rot+'deg);image-rendering:pixelated;'+
        'image-rendering:crisp-edges;transition:opacity 0.4s;';
      layer.appendChild(img);
    });
  }

  /* ---- deck: delayed-snap + reveal + dot/keyboard navigation ---- */
  if('scrollRestoration' in history){ try{ history.scrollRestoration='manual'; }catch(e){} }
  try{ window.scrollTo(0,0); }catch(e){}

  var root=document.documentElement, snapTimer=null;
  function enableSnap(){ root.classList.add('snap-on'); }
  function suspendSnap(ms){ root.classList.remove('snap-on'); clearTimeout(snapTimer); snapTimer=setTimeout(enableSnap, ms||900); }
  function goTo(pg){ suspendSnap(900); pg.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'}); }

  function initDeck(){
    if(document.querySelector('.deck-dots')) return;
    var pages=Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.page'));
    if(!pages.length) return;
    var nav=document.createElement('div'); nav.className='deck-dots';
    
    pages.forEach(function(pg,i){
      var b=document.createElement('button'); b.type='button';
      b.setAttribute('aria-label','Seite '+(i+1));
      b.addEventListener('click',function(){ goTo(pg); });
      nav.appendChild(b);
    });
    document.body.appendChild(nav);
    var dots=nav.children, current=0;
    
    var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
      entries.forEach(function(e){
        if(e.isIntersecting && e.intersectionRatio>=0.55){
          e.target.classList.add('in-view');
          current=pages.indexOf(e.target);
          
          // ---> SWAP SPRITES ON PAGE SCROLL <---
          if (currentPageIndex !== current) {
             currentPageIndex = current;
             placeSprites();
          }
          
          for(var k=0;k<dots.length;k++){ dots[k].classList.toggle('active', k===current); }
        }
      });
    },{threshold:[0.55]});
    
    pages.forEach(function(p){ io.observe(p); });
    
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(ev){
      if(ev.key==='ArrowDown'||ev.key==='PageDown'){ if(current<pages.length-1){ ev.preventDefault(); goTo(pages[current+1]); } }
      else if(ev.key==='ArrowUp'||ev.key==='PageUp'){ if(current>0){ ev.preventDefault(); goTo(pages[current-1]); } }
    });
  }

  function boot(){ drawField(); placeSprites(); initDeck(); }
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot);
  window.addEventListener('load', function(){ boot(); setTimeout(enableSnap, 1600); });
  setTimeout(boot, 600);
  setTimeout(enableSnap, 3500);            /* fallback if 'load' is delayed */
  window.addEventListener('resize', function(){ drawField(); placeSprites(); suspendSnap(700); });
})();
</script>
```

```{python}
#| label: setup
import json, warnings, base64 as _b64, io as _io, os as _os
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import plotly, plotly.graph_objects as go
from collections import deque as _deque
from PIL import Image as _PILImage
from IPython.display import HTML, display
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

# Write plotly.min.js inline into _plotly_inject.html so Quarto includes it in <head>.
# include-in-header is processed by Pandoc BEFORE --embed-resources, so the JS
# lands inline in the final self-contained HTML — bypassing the file:// CORS block.
_pjs_path = _os.path.join(_os.path.dirname(plotly.__file__), 'package_data', 'plotly.min.js')
with open(_pjs_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as _pf:
    _pjs = _pf.read()
with open('_plotly_inject.html', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as _hf:
    _hf.write(f'<script type="text/javascript">\n{_pjs}\n</script>\n')

TOP5    = ['GB1','ES1','L1','IT1','FR1']
LNAMES  = {'GB1':'Premier League','ES1':'La Liga','L1':'Bundesliga','IT1':'Serie A','FR1':'Ligue 1'}
# Palette tuned for the dark-green pitch: softened from the original neon tones,
# and Serie A moved from green (which vanished against the pitch) to an azure
# that also fits Italy's azzurri. Each hue is well separated for legibility.
LCOLORS = {'GB1':'#22D3E0','ES1':'#F2B705','L1':'#E8503A','IT1':'#5C8DEF','FR1':'#E8E2CF'}

# ── Load JSONL (club-level per season) ─────────────────────
rows = []
for _lg in TOP5:
    with open(f'data/{_lg}_long.jsonl') as _f:
        for _line in _f:
            _d = json.loads(_line)
            _d['competition_id'] = _lg
            rows.append(_d)
df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
df['season'] = df['season'].astype(int)
df = df[df['season'].between(2010, 2024)]

# ── Load CSV data ──────────────────────────────────────────
clubs = pd.read_csv('data/transfermarkt/clubs.csv')[['club_id','domestic_competition_id']]
tr_raw = pd.read_csv('data/transfermarkt/transfers.csv')
pv_raw = pd.read_csv('data/transfermarkt/player_valuations.csv')
players = pd.read_csv('data/transfermarkt/players.csv')[['player_id','name','sub_position']]
games = pd.read_csv('data/transfermarkt/games.csv')

# ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────
def parse_season(s):
    try: return 2000 + int(str(s)[:2])
    except: return None

def hex_to_rgba(h, a=0.35):
    h = h.lstrip('#')
    r,g,b = int(h[0:2],16), int(h[2:4],16), int(h[4:6],16)
    return f'rgba({r},{g},{b},{a})'

def themed(fig, height=620):
    fig.update_layout(
        height=height,
        dragmode=False,
        paper_bgcolor='rgba(0,0,0,0)',
        plot_bgcolor='rgba(0,0,0,0.22)',
        font=dict(color='rgba(255,255,255,0.82)',
                  family='Aptos Light,Helvetica Neue,sans-serif', size=15),
        legend=dict(bgcolor='rgba(0,0,0,0)', borderwidth=0,
                    font=dict(color='rgba(255,255,255,0.78)', size=14)),
        hoverlabel=dict(bgcolor='rgba(10,10,10,0.88)',
                        bordercolor='rgba(255,255,255,0.18)',
                        font=dict(color='#fff', size=14)),
        margin=dict(l=68, r=20, t=36, b=58)
    )
    fig.update_xaxes(
        gridcolor='rgba(255,255,255,0.07)',
        linecolor='rgba(255,255,255,0.25)',
        tickfont=dict(color='rgba(255,255,255,0.72)', size=15),
        title_font=dict(color='rgba(255,255,255,0.62)', size=16)
    )
    fig.update_yaxes(
        gridcolor='rgba(255,255,255,0.07)',
        linecolor='rgba(255,255,255,0)',
        tickfont=dict(color='rgba(255,255,255,0.72)', size=15),
        title_font=dict(color='rgba(255,255,255,0.62)', size=16)
    )
    return fig

def ch(fig):
    return fig.to_html(
        full_html=False, include_plotlyjs=False,
        config={'responsive': True, 'displayModeBar': False,
                'scrollZoom': False, 'doubleClick': False}
    )

def sec(label, h2, story, chart_str, hl='', hl_type='gold', cap='', bridge=''):
    hl_s  = f'<div class="highlight-box {hl_type}"><p>{hl}</p></div>' if hl else ''
    cap_s = f'<div class="chart-caption">{cap}</div>' if cap else ''
    br_s  = f'<p class="bridge-line">{bridge}</p>' if bridge else ''
    return (f'<section class="page"><div class="page-inner spread">'
            f'<div class="col-text">'
            f'<p class="section-label">{label}</p>'
            f'<h2>{h2}</h2>'
            f'<p class="story-text">{story}</p>'
            f'{hl_s}{br_s}'
            f'</div>'
            f'<div class="col-chart">{chart_str}{cap_s}</div>'
            f'</div></section>')

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 1 — Kadermarktwerte
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
mv_df = df.groupby(['competition_id','season'])['total_market_value'].sum().reset_index()
mv_pivot = mv_df.pivot(index='season', columns='competition_id', values='total_market_value').fillna(0) / 1e9

ratio_s = pd.DataFrame({
    'season': mv_pivot.index,
    'ratio': (mv_pivot['GB1'] / mv_pivot[['ES1','L1','IT1','FR1']].mean(axis=1)).values
})

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Transfers
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
tr = tr_raw.copy()
tr['yr'] = tr['transfer_season'].apply(parse_season)
tr = tr.dropna(subset=['yr']); tr['yr'] = tr['yr'].astype(int)
tr = tr.merge(clubs.rename(columns={'club_id':'from_club_id','domestic_competition_id':'from_league'}),
              on='from_club_id', how='left')
tr = tr.merge(clubs.rename(columns={'club_id':'to_club_id','domestic_competition_id':'to_league'}),
              on='to_club_id', how='left')

tr5 = tr[tr['from_league'].isin(TOP5) & tr['to_league'].isin(TOP5) &
         (tr['transfer_fee'] > 0) & (tr['from_league'] != tr['to_league']) &
         tr['yr'].between(2010, 2024)].copy()

sankey_flows = tr5.groupby(['from_league','to_league'])['transfer_fee'].sum().reset_index()
sankey_flows['fee_m'] = (sankey_flows['transfer_fee'] / 1e6).round(1)

# Net balance per league per season (from jsonl: all transfers)
net_df = df.groupby(['competition_id','season'])['net_transfer_record'].sum().reset_index()
net_df['net_m'] = (net_df['net_transfer_record'] / 1e6).round(1)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DATA: Section 3 — Spielerwert-Konzentration
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
pv = pv_raw.copy()
pv['date'] = pd.to_datetime(pv['date'], errors='coerce')
pv5 = pv[pv['player_club_domestic_competition_id'].isin(TOP5)]
latest_pv = pv5.sort_values('date').groupby('player_id').last().reset_index()
latest_pv = latest_pv[latest_pv['market_value_in_eur'] >= 5e6].merge(
    players, on='player_id', how='left'
)
top500 = latest_pv.nlargest(500, 'market_value_in_eur').copy()
top500['mv_m'] = top500['market_value_in_eur'] / 1e6
np.random.seed(42)
top500['jitter'] = np.random.uniform(-0.38, 0.38, len(top500))
top500['lg_idx'] = top500['player_club_domestic_competition_id'].map(
    {lg: i for i, lg in enumerate(TOP5)}
)
top500['y_pos'] = top500['lg_idx'] + top500['jitter']

# Treemap: latest season club MVs
tm_df = df[df['season'] == 2024].copy()
# branchvalues='remainder': parent values are ADDED to children, so set parents=0.
# Leaf clubs carry all the area → no rounding mismatch possible.
tm_labels  = ['Gesamt']
tm_parents = ['']
tm_values  = [0]          # root contributes no extra area
tm_colors  = ['rgba(0,0,0,0)']
tm_text    = ['']
for _lg in TOP5:
    _d = tm_df[tm_df['competition_id'] == _lg].nlargest(12, 'total_market_value')
    _total = int(_d['total_market_value'].sum() / 1e6)
    tm_labels.append(LNAMES[_lg]); tm_parents.append('Gesamt')
    tm_values.append(0)             # league contributes no extra area
    tm_colors.append(LCOLORS[_lg])
    tm_text.append(f'€{_total/1000:.1f}B')
    for _, _r in _d.iterrows():
        _mv = int(_r['total_market_value'] / 1e6)
        tm_labels.append(_r['name']); tm_parents.append(LNAMES[_lg])
        tm_values.append(_mv)
        tm_colors.append(hex_to_rgba(LCOLORS[_lg], 0.72))
        tm_text.append(f'€{_mv}M')

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DATA: Section 4 — Wettbewerb
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
g5 = games[games['competition_id'].isin(TOP5) & games['season'].between(2010, 2024)].copy()
g5['home_pts'] = np.where(g5['home_club_goals'] > g5['away_club_goals'], 3,
                 np.where(g5['home_club_goals'] == g5['away_club_goals'], 1, 0))
g5['away_pts'] = np.where(g5['away_club_goals'] > g5['home_club_goals'], 3,
                 np.where(g5['home_club_goals'] == g5['away_club_goals'], 1, 0))

home_r = g5[['competition_id','season','home_club_id','home_club_name','home_pts']].rename(
    columns={'home_club_id':'club_id','home_club_name':'club_name','home_pts':'pts'})
away_r = g5[['competition_id','season','away_club_id','away_club_name','away_pts']].rename(
    columns={'away_club_id':'club_id','away_club_name':'club_name','away_pts':'pts'})
all_pts = pd.concat([home_r, away_r])
standings = all_pts.groupby(['competition_id','season','club_id','club_name'])['pts'].sum().reset_index()
standings['rank'] = standings.groupby(['competition_id','season'])['pts'].rank(
    ascending=False, method='min').astype(int)

# Join with club MV from jsonl
df_mv = df[['club_id','season','total_market_value','competition_id']].copy()
scatter_df = standings.merge(df_mv, on=['club_id','season','competition_id'], how='inner')
scatter_df = scatter_df[scatter_df['total_market_value'] > 0].copy()
scatter_df['mv_m'] = scatter_df['total_market_value'] / 1e6

# MV rank within each league-season (1 = richest)
scatter_df['mv_rank'] = scatter_df.groupby(['competition_id','season'])['mv_m'].rank(
    ascending=False, method='first').astype(int)
scatter_df['n_clubs'] = scatter_df.groupby(['competition_id','season'])['club_id'].transform('count')

def _mv_grp(r, n):
    p = r / n
    if p <= 0.25:  return '① Top-25%'
    elif p <= 0.60: return '② Mittelfeld'
    else:           return '③ Unteres Drittel'

scatter_df['mv_grp'] = scatter_df.apply(lambda x: _mv_grp(x['mv_rank'], x['n_clubs']), axis=1)
_grp_order = ['① Top-25%', '② Mittelfeld', '③ Unteres Drittel']
grp_avg = (scatter_df
    .groupby(['competition_id','mv_grp'])['rank']
    .mean().reset_index()
    .rename(columns={'rank':'avg_rank'}))

# Top-4 share of total MV per league-season (replaces Gini)
def _top4_share(g):
    tot = g['total_market_value'].sum()
    return g.nlargest(4,'total_market_value')['total_market_value'].sum() / tot * 100 if tot else np.nan

top4_df = df.groupby(['competition_id','season']).apply(_top4_share).reset_index()
top4_df.columns = ['competition_id','season','top4_pct']

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DATA: Section 5 — Brain Drain / PL Tax
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
tr_pl = tr[(tr['to_league'] == 'GB1') &
           (tr['transfer_fee'] > 1e6) &
           (tr['market_value_in_eur'] > 1e6) &
           tr['from_league'].isin(TOP5)].copy()
tr_pl['fee_m']     = tr_pl['transfer_fee'] / 1e6
tr_pl['mv_m']      = tr_pl['market_value_in_eur'] / 1e6
tr_pl['premium']   = ((tr_pl['fee_m'] / tr_pl['mv_m']) - 1) * 100
tr_pl = tr_pl[tr_pl['mv_m'] >= 5].copy()

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# KPIs for hero
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
_total_mv_2024   = mv_pivot.loc[2024, TOP5].sum()
_total_mv_2010   = mv_pivot.loc[2010, TOP5].sum()
_mv_growth       = int((_total_mv_2024 - _total_mv_2010) / _total_mv_2010 * 100)
_total_transfers = tr5['transfer_fee'].sum() / 1e9
_top_league      = mv_pivot.loc[2024, TOP5].idxmax()
_top_league_name = LNAMES[_top_league]
_top_league_mv   = mv_pivot.loc[2024, _top_league]
_num_transfers   = len(tr5)

# ── Intro-tile metrics ─────────────────────────────────────
# Number of distinct seasons covered by the dataset (2010–2024).
_n_seasons = int(df['season'].nunique())
# Distinct clubs that appeared in any top-5 league across all seasons
# (more than 5×20 because promotion/relegation churns the membership).
_n_teams = int(df['club_id'].dropna().nunique())
# Total transfers considered: every move with a known fee that touches a
# top-5 league (incoming or outgoing) across the 15 seasons. Reference
# figure used in the dashboard.
_n_transfers_considered = 10852
_transfers_fmt = f'{_n_transfers_considered:,}'.replace(',', "'")
# Total transfer fee (EUR) of all moves with a known fee that involve a top-5
# league as either buyer OR seller, 2010–2025 — summed inline from the merged
# transfers table (tr already carries from_league / to_league).
_fee_either_top5 = tr[(tr['from_league'].isin(TOP5) | tr['to_league'].isin(TOP5)) &
                      tr['yr'].between(2010, 2025)]['transfer_fee'].sum()
_total_fee_fmt = f'€{_fee_either_top5 / 1e9:.0f} Mrd.'   # ≈ €70 Mrd.

# ── Load SVG logos as base64 data URIs ────────────────────
import os as _os, base64 as _b64_logo
_LOGO_FILES = {'GB1':'pl','ES1':'laliga','L1':'bundesliga','IT1':'seriea','FR1':'ligue1'}
_LOGOS = {}
for _lg, _fn in _LOGO_FILES.items():
    try:
        with open(f'logos/{_fn}.svg','rb') as _lf:
            _b = _b64_logo.b64encode(_lf.read()).decode()
        _LOGOS[_lg] = f'data:image/svg+xml;base64,{_b}'
    except:
        _LOGOS[_lg] = ''

# ── Transfermarkt wordmark (PNG) as base64 data URI ───────
try:
    with open('logos/transfermarkt-logo.png','rb') as _tmf:
        _TM_LOGO = 'data:image/png;base64,' + _b64_logo.b64encode(_tmf.read()).decode()
except:
    _TM_LOGO = ''

# ── Sprite background removal ─────────────────────────────
def _remove_bg(path, tol=22):
    img = _PILImage.open(path).convert('RGBA')
    arr = np.array(img, dtype=np.int32)
    bg  = arr[0, 0, :3]
    h, w = arr.shape[:2]
    alpha   = arr[:, :, 3].copy()
    visited = np.zeros((h, w), dtype=bool)
    q = _deque()
    for r, c in [(0,0),(0,w-1),(h-1,0),(h-1,w-1)]:
        if not visited[r,c]: q.append((r,c)); visited[r,c] = True
    while q:
        r, c = q.popleft()
        if np.abs(arr[r,c,:3] - bg).max() <= tol:
            alpha[r,c] = 0
            for nr, nc in [(r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)]:
                if 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w and not visited[nr,nc]:
                    visited[nr,nc] = True; q.append((nr,nc))
    arr[:,:,3] = alpha
    buf = _io.BytesIO()
    _PILImage.fromarray(arr.astype(np.uint8)).save(buf, 'PNG')
    return 'data:image/png;base64,' + _b64.b64encode(buf.getvalue()).decode()

_sprite_b64 = []
for _i in range(1, 56):
    try:    _sprite_b64.append(_remove_bg(f'assets/sprite_{_i:02d}.png'))
    except: _sprite_b64.append('')

_sprites_js = 'var SPRITES=' + json.dumps(_sprite_b64) + ';'
display(HTML(f'<script>{_sprites_js}</script>'))
```

```{python}
<script>
(function(){
  var ID = "%s";
  function ready(){
    var gd = document.getElementById(ID);
    if(!gd || typeof Plotly === "undefined" || !gd.on){ return setTimeout(ready, 150); }
    function plShown(){
      var t = gd.data && gd.data[0];
      if(!t) return true;
      return t.visible === true || t.visible === undefined;
    }
    function sync(){
      var show = plShown(), u = {};
      (gd.layout.annotations || []).forEach(function(a, i){
        if(a.name === "tv_anno"){ u["annotations[" + i + "].visible"] = show; }
      });
      (gd.layout.shapes || []).forEach(function(s, i){
        if(s.name === "tv_vline"){ u["shapes[" + i + "].visible"] = show; }
      });
      if(Object.keys(u).length){ Plotly.relayout(gd, u); }
    }
    gd.on("plotly_restyle", sync);
    sync();
  }
  ready();
})();
</script>
''' % _chart_id
```

```{python}
def _season_label(yr):
    return f'{yr}/{str(yr + 1)[2:]}'

def _flow_view(_data):
    """Return (values, labels) for the 20 fixed pairs from a transfer slice."""
    g = _data.groupby(['from_league', 'to_league'])['transfer_fee'].sum().div(1e6)
    vals, labs = [], []
    for s, t in _pairs:
        v = float(g.get((s, t), 0.0))
        vals.append(round(v, 1))
        labs.append(f'{LNAMES[s]} → {LNAMES[t]}: €{v:,.0f}M'
                    if v > 0 else f'{LNAMES[s]} → {LNAMES[t]}: kein Transfer')
    return vals, labs

        type='dropdown', direction='down',
        x=0.0, xanchor='left', y=1.16, yanchor='top',
        active=0, showactive=True, buttons=_buttons,
        bgcolor='rgba(10,28,12,0.96)', bordercolor='rgba(255,255,255,0.28)',
        borderwidth=1,
        font=dict(color='rgba(255,255,255,0.92)', size=13.5),
        pad=dict(l=6, r=6, t=4, b=4)
    )]
)

_pl_in  = tr5[tr5['to_league'] == 'GB1'].groupby('from_league')['transfer_fee'].sum().div(1e9)
_pl_out = tr5[tr5['from_league'] == 'GB1']['transfer_fee'].sum() / 1e9
_pl_in_total = _pl_in.sum()
_pl_net = _pl_in_total - _pl_out
_ranked = _pl_in.sort_values(ascending=False)
_lines = ', '.join(f'aus {LNAMES[lg]} <strong>€{v:.1f} Mrd.</strong>'
                   for lg, v in _ranked.items())

display(HTML(sec(
    'III',
    'Transfers zwischen Top-5-Ligen',
    ('Links steht jede Liga als <em>abgebende</em> Seite, rechts dieselbe Liga als '
     '<em>aufnehmende</em> Seite; die Breite eines Bandes entspricht der Ablösesumme, die '
     'zwischen den beiden Ligen geflossen ist. Über das Menü lässt sich eine einzelne Saison '
     'oder der gesamte Zeitraum betrachten. Der aufnehmende Block der Premier League ist dabei '
     'der mit Abstand grösste: Sie verpflichtet aus allen vier anderen Ligen mehr Spieler, als '
     'sie dorthin abgibt.'),
    ch(fig),
    hl=(f'Die grössten Zuflüsse in die Premier League (2010–2024): {_lines}. '
        f'Insgesamt flossen <strong>€{_pl_in_total:.1f} Mrd.</strong> nach England, während nur '
        f'<strong>€{_pl_out:.1f} Mrd.</strong> in die andere Richtung gingen — ein Negativsaldo '
        f'von <strong>€{_pl_net:.1f} Mrd.</strong> allein im Handel zwischen den Top-5-Ligen.'),
    hl_type='gold',
    cap='Transfers zwischen verschiedenen Top-5-Ligen mit bekannter Ablösesumme · Saison über das Menü wählbar'
)))
```

```{python}
fig = go.Figure()

# 1. Sort data and calculate the cumulative sum per league
net_df = net_df.sort_values(['competition_id', 'season'])
net_df['cum_net_m'] = net_df.groupby('competition_id')['net_m'].cumsum()

# 2. Draw thick, clear lines
for lg in TOP5:
    _d = net_df[net_df['competition_id']==lg]
```

```{python}
#| label: s3a-concentration
# Chart 3A: Smooth Stacked Area, Top 150 players by MV over time

# Map valuations to seasons
pv = pv_raw.copy()
pv['date'] = pd.to_datetime(pv['date'], errors='coerce')
pv5 = pv[pv['player_club_domestic_competition_id'].isin(TOP5)].copy()

# Determine season based on valuation date (valuations from July 1st onwards count towards that year's season)
pv5['season'] = pv5['date'].dt.year - (pv5['date'].dt.month < 7).astype(int)
pv5 = pv5[pv5['season'].between(2010, 2024)]

# Get the latest valuation for each player within each season
season_pv = pv5.sort_values('date').groupby(['season', 'player_id']).last().reset_index()
season_pv['mv_m'] = season_pv['market_value_in_eur'] / 1e6

# Filter to the top 150 most valuable players per season
top150_per_season = season_pv.groupby('season', group_keys=False).apply(lambda x: x.nlargest(150, 'mv_m'))

# Aggregate player counts per league per season and pivot for the area chart
league_counts = top150_per_season.groupby(['season', 'player_club_domestic_competition_id']).size().reset_index(name='count')
pivot_counts = league_counts.pivot(index='season', columns='player_club_domestic_competition_id', values='count').fillna(0)

# Ensure all seasons are present
seasons_range = list(range(2010, 2025))
pivot_counts = pivot_counts.reindex(seasons_range).fillna(0)

fig = go.Figure()

# Generate smooth stacked area traces
# TOP5 order puts GB1 at the bottom, creating a beautiful "rising tide" effect
for lg in TOP5:
    _color = LCOLORS[lg]
    # Use the hex_to_rgba helper from your setup block for a softer fill
    _rgba_fill = hex_to_rgba(_color, 0.75) 
    
    # Safely get the column data, or a series of 0s if the league dropped out entirely
    _y_data = pivot_counts[lg] if lg in pivot_counts.columns else pd.Series(0, index=pivot_counts.index)
    
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
        x=pivot_counts.index,
        y=_y_data,
        name=LNAMES[lg],
        mode='lines',
        line=dict(width=2, color=_color, shape='spline', smoothing=0.8),
        stackgroup='one', # This makes it stack dynamically
        fillcolor=_rgba_fill,
        hovertemplate='<b>%{x}</b><br>' + LNAMES[lg] + ': %{y} Spieler<extra></extra>'
    ))

fig.update_layout(
    xaxis_title='Saison',
    yaxis_title='Anzahl Spieler (Top 150)',
    # Lock the Y-axis to 150 since we are strictly looking at the top 150 players
    yaxis=dict(range=[0, 150], fixedrange=True),
    legend=dict(orientation='h', yanchor='bottom', y=1.01, xanchor='left', x=0)
)
themed(fig, height=650)

_chart_id_concentration = 'chart-concentration'
_chart_html_concentration = fig.to_html(
    full_html=False, include_plotlyjs=False, div_id=_chart_id_concentration,
    config={'responsive': True, 'displayModeBar': False, 'scrollZoom': False}
)

display(HTML(sec(
    'V',
    'Verteilung der Top-150-Spieler nach Marktwert',
    ('Das Flächendiagramm zeigt, wie sich die 150 wertvollsten Spieler einer Saison auf die fünf '
     'Ligen verteilen. 2010 waren sie noch vergleichsweise gleichmässig verteilt; im Lauf der '
     'Jahre verschob sich ein zunehmender Anteil in die Premier League.'),
    _chart_html_concentration,
    hl=('Die Premier League hortet mittlerweile <strong> fast gleich viele </strong> Top-150-Spieler, als die anderen vier Top-Ligen '
        'zusammen.'),
    hl_type='gold',
    cap='Die 150 wertvollsten Spieler pro Saison'
)))
```

```{python}
#| label: s4a-mv-corr
# ── Chart 4A: Pearson correlation MV vs. final rank per league per season ─
from scipy.stats import pearsonr

corr_rows = []
for lg in TOP5:
    for ssn, grp in scatter_df[scatter_df['competition_id']==lg].groupby('season'):
        if len(grp) >= 5:
            r, _ = pearsonr(grp['mv_m'], -grp['rank'])
            corr_rows.append({'competition_id': lg, 'season': ssn, 'r': round(r, 3)})
corr_df = pd.DataFrame(corr_rows)

fig = go.Figure()
for lg in TOP5:
    _d = corr_df[corr_df['competition_id']==lg].sort_values('season')
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
        x=_d['season'], y=_d['r'],
        mode='lines+markers',
        name=LNAMES[lg],
        line=dict(color=LCOLORS[lg], width=2),
        marker=dict(size=5, color=LCOLORS[lg]),
        hovertemplate='<b>%{x}</b>: r = %{y:.2f}<extra>' + LNAMES[lg] + '</extra>'
    ))
fig.add_hline(y=0, line_color='rgba(255,255,255,0.2)', line_dash='dot')
fig.update_layout(
    xaxis_title='Saison',
    yaxis=dict(title='Pearson-Korrelation (Kaderwert ↔ Tabellenplatz)', range=[-0.1, 1.05]),
    legend=dict(orientation='h', yanchor='bottom', y=1.01, xanchor='left', x=0)
)
themed(fig, height=620)

display(HTML(sec(
    'VI',
    'Korrelation zwischen Kadermarktwert und Liga-Erfolg',
    ('Die Pearson-Korrelation misst, wie eng Kaderwert und Tabellenplatz zusammenhängen '
     '(1.0 = vollständige Übereinstimmung, 0 = kein Zusammenhang); Werte über 0.7 gelten als '
     'starker Zusammenhang. In allen fünf Ligen liegt die Korrelation seit Jahren hoch: Wer über '
     'den wertvolleren Kader verfügt, schliesst die Saison in der Regel weiter oben ab.'),
    ch(fig),
    hl=('Die Korrelation bewegt sich in allen Ligen recht stabil zwischen 0.6 und 0.9, mit '
        'leichten Schwankungen je Saison. <strong>Der Zusammenhang zwischen Kaderwert und Erfolg '
        'besteht damit ligaübergreifend.</strong>'),
    cap='Pearson-Korrelation pro Saison und Liga · Kaderwert und Abschlusstabellenplatz (2010–2024)'
)))
```

```{python}
#| label: fazit-slopegraph
# ── Fazit: slopegraph 2010 → 2024, squad market value per league ─
_yr0, _yr1 = 2010, 2024
_order = sorted(TOP5, key=lambda lg: mv_pivot.loc[_yr1, lg], reverse=True)

fig = go.Figure()
for lg in _order:
    _v0, _v1 = mv_pivot.loc[_yr0, lg], mv_pivot.loc[_yr1, lg]
    _is_pl = (lg == 'GB1')
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
        x=[_yr0, _yr1], y=[_v0, _v1],
        mode='lines+markers',
        name=LNAMES[lg],
        line=dict(color=LCOLORS[lg], width=4 if _is_pl else 2),
        marker=dict(size=9 if _is_pl else 7, color=LCOLORS[lg]),
        opacity=1.0 if _is_pl else 0.8,
        hovertemplate='<b>%{x}</b>: €%{y:.2f} Mrd.<extra>' + LNAMES[lg] + '</extra>'
    ))

def _eur(v):
    return '€' + ('%.1f' % v).replace('.', ',') + ' Mrd.'

# Right-hand (2024) value labels with a minimum vertical gap so the clustered
# leagues stay legible; text is coloured per league to tie it to its line.
_gap, _last, _ann = 0.62, None, []
for lg in _order:                                  # sorted high → low
    _v1 = mv_pivot.loc[_yr1, lg]
    _yl = _v1 if _last is None else min(_v1, _last - _gap)
    _last = _yl
    _txt = _eur(_v1)
    if lg == 'GB1':
        _txt += (' (×%.1f)' % (mv_pivot.loc[_yr1, lg] / mv_pivot.loc[_yr0, lg])).replace('.', ',')
    _font = dict(color=LCOLORS[lg], size=15 if lg == 'GB1' else 14)
    if lg == 'GB1':
        _font['family'] = 'Oswald'
    _ann.append(dict(x=_yr1 + 0.5, y=_yl, xref='x', yref='y', text=_txt,
                     showarrow=False, xanchor='left', font=_font))

# Anchor the standout line on the left as well.
_ann.append(dict(x=_yr0 - 0.5, y=mv_pivot.loc[_yr0, 'GB1'], xref='x', yref='y',
                 text=_eur(mv_pivot.loc[_yr0, 'GB1']), showarrow=False,
                 xanchor='right', font=dict(color=LCOLORS['GB1'], size=14)))

fig.update_layout(
    xaxis=dict(tickmode='array', tickvals=[_yr0, _yr1],
               ticktext=[str(_yr0), str(_yr1)], range=[2005.5, 2028.5], showgrid=False),
    yaxis=dict(title='Kadermarktwert (Mrd. €)', range=[0, 14]),
    legend=dict(orientation='h', yanchor='bottom', y=1.02, xanchor='left', x=0),
    annotations=_ann
)
themed(fig, height=600)
fig.update_xaxes(showgrid=False)

display(HTML(sec(
    'Fazit',
    'Aus einem engen Feld wird ein klarer Abstand',
    ('Über fünfzehn Saisons ergibt sich ein einheitliches Bild. 2010 lagen die fünf Ligen '
     'finanziell noch nah beieinander; die Premier League führte, aber mit überschaubarem '
     'Abstand. In den Jahren danach stiegen die Kaderwerte überall — in England jedoch deutlich '
     'schneller als auf dem Kontinent. Heute erreicht die Premier League rund das Doppelte der '
     'nächstgrössten Liga und etwa die Hälfte des gesamten Kaderwerts der fünf Ligen. Höhere '
     'Kaderwerte gehen dabei in allen Ligen mit besseren Tabellenplätzen einher, und die '
     'Transferströme verstärken die Entwicklung, weil Talent überwiegend in Richtung der '
     'finanzstärksten Liga wandert.'),
    ch(fig),
    hl=('2010 bewegten sich fünf Ligen in einer ähnlichen Grössenordnung. Fünfzehn Saisons '
        'später bildet die Premier League finanziell <strong>eine eigene Kategorie.</strong>'),
    hl_type='gold',
    cap=('Kadermarktwert je Liga zu Saisonbeginn 2010 und 2024 · Marktwert = Summe der '
         'geschätzten Spielerwerte eines Kaders, nicht Vereins- oder Unternehmenswert')
)))
```
